primaryResearch.applicableComponent: .github/workflows/pages.yml phase dependencies and required test gate
primaryResearch.sourceFact: needs requires successful completion; failure or skipped dependency skips downstream jobs unless an explicit always() condition permits continuation.
primaryResearch.decision: Use dependency barriers between specification proof phases. Keep required test if: always() and explicit success checks so earlier failure makes required test fail rather than silently skipping.
primaryResearch.verification: Read workflow dependency edges and exact guard; focused source-mutation controls owned by verify-verified-site.mjs; hosted required check remains necessary.
primaryResearch.authority: Official GitHub Actions documentation; platform behavior/guidance, not additional controlling application requirements

primaryResearch.applicableComponent: same-run prerequisite/conformance/deferred receipt handoff and PR artifact reuse
primaryResearch.sourceFact: upload/download-artifact share artifacts between workflow jobs; consumers require needs; other-run download needs token and run identifier; v4 artifacts are immutable; automatic artifact digest mismatch produces a warning.
primaryResearch.decision: Keep exact current-run artifact selectors and repository source-bound receipt owner validation; do not equate artifact download or warning-only digest behavior with accepted proof. PR promotion retains explicit run, attempt, head/tree, workflow, manifest and resource equality checks.
primaryResearch.verification: Read current receipt validation and assertPassedRun/promotion gates; focused missing, stale, failed, malformed and wrong-input negative controls. No platform compromise claim.
primaryResearch.authority: Official GitHub Actions documentation; platform behavior/guidance, not additional controlling application requirements

primaryResearch.applicableComponent: job permissions for checkout, Actions PR-artifact discovery, deployment and status publication
primaryResearch.sourceFact: Actions can access github.token even without explicitly receiving it; use permissions at workflow/job scope to grant only least required access.
primaryResearch.decision: Retain default contents: read and scoped actions: read/pull-requests: read where PR verification discovery actually needs it. Do not add write permissions to proof jobs. Existing deployment/publication owners retain their necessary scopes.
primaryResearch.verification: Compare workflow permission declarations before/after and actual API calls used by verified-site.mjs.
primaryResearch.authority: Official GitHub Actions documentation; platform behavior/guidance, not additional controlling application requirements

primaryResearch.applicableComponent: three isolated conformance jobs and required downstream result checks
primaryResearch.sourceFact: strategy.fail-fast controls cancellation of other matrix jobs on failure; continue-on-error changes failure propagation independently.
primaryResearch.decision: Retain fail-fast: false to allow independent diagnostics to complete, no continue-on-error for required proof, and aggregate needs.conformance.result success guard plus exact three job outcomes when promoting a PR artifact.
primaryResearch.verification: Read YAML and promotion checks; required negative controls for failed/missing/skipped group execution/upload; no duplicate full benchmarking run.
primaryResearch.authority: Official GitHub Actions documentation; platform behavior/guidance, not additional controlling application requirements
